name: Employee Management
definition: The process of managing all aspects related to employees, including onboarding, information management, salary management, performance evaluation, offboarding, and department assignment.
activities: Human Resources managers review job applications and select candidates for interviews
HR assistants schedule interviews with potential employees
HR managers conduct interviews and make hiring decisions
HR managers enter new employee information into the HumanResources Employee table
HR assistants assign departments to new hires by updating the HumanResources EmployeeDepartmentHistory table
HR managers verify and approve employee updates
HR assistants update employee records in the HumanResources EmployeeDepartmentHistory table when employees change departments
HR managers determine employee salaries based on job titles and performance evaluations
Payroll specialists update the HumanResources EmployeePayHistory table with new salary rates and pay frequencies
HR managers terminate employees' contracts and update their status in the HumanResources Employee table
HR managers manage employee departures by updating the EndDate in the HumanResources EmployeeDepartmentHistory table
emb_input: Business concept: Employee Management. Definition: The process of managing all aspects related to employees, including onboarding, information management, salary management, performance evaluation, offboarding, and department assignment. Performed by: Human Resources Managers, HR Assistants, Employees. Data artifacts produced: HumanResources Employee table, HumanResources EmployeeDepartmentHistory table, HumanResources EmployeePayHistory table.
